mapper.sql: r.id AS renewal_id, r.request_id, r.service_account_id, a.account AS account_name, a.cors_account_id, r.owner_company_id, dc.company_name AS owner_company_name, r.assigned_user_id, r.service_code_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.service_code_snapshot, '$.code')), ''), sc.code) AS service_code, r.spec_code, gb.display_name, r.service_type, r.duration_days, r.status, a.expire_at AS current_account_expire_at, r.last_error_code, r.last_error_message, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.completed_at

FROM account_renewal r LEFT JOIN service_account a ON a.id = r.service_account_id LEFT JOIN service_code sc ON sc.id = r.service_code_id LEFT JOIN service_code_generate_batch gb ON gb.id = sc.generate_batch_id LEFT JOIN dealer_company dc ON dc.company_id = r.owner_company_id

sql.if: AND ( r.request_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.cors_account_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.service_code_snapshot, '$.code')) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR gb.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dc.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.operator_user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
